measures.name: Net Units YoY %
measures.expression:
VAR _first = CALCULATE ( MIN ( dim_date[date] ), ALL ( dim_date ) )
VAR _start = MIN ( dim_date[date] )
VAR _end   = MAX ( dim_date[date] )

-- Selection starts in the first year but runs beyond it (e.g. no slicer, or all years)
VAR _useLatestYTD = _start < EDATE ( _first, 12 ) && _end >= EDATE ( _first, 12 )

VAR _curStart  = IF ( _useLatestYTD, DATE ( YEAR ( _end ), 1, 1 ), _start )
VAR _prevStart = EDATE ( _curStart, -12 )

VAR _cur =
    IF (
        _useLatestYTD,
        CALCULATE (
            [Net Units],
            REMOVEFILTERS ( dim_date ),
            DATESBETWEEN ( dim_date[date], _curStart, _end )
        ),
        [Net Units]
    )

VAR _prev =
    IF (
        _useLatestYTD,
        CALCULATE (
            [Net Units],
            REMOVEFILTERS ( dim_date ),
            DATESBETWEEN ( dim_date[date], _prevStart, EDATE ( _end, -12 ) )
        ),
        CALCULATE ( [Net Units], DATEADD ( dim_date[date], -1, YEAR ) )
    )

RETURN
    IF ( _prevStart < _first, BLANK (), DIVIDE ( _cur - _prev, _prev ) )

measures.name: Sparkline Net Units
measures.expression:
VAR _w = 120
VAR _h = 36
VAR _p = 3
VAR _lastKey =
    MAXX ( ALL ( dim_date[year], dim_date[month] ), dim_date[year] * 100 + dim_date[month] )
VAR _m =
    FILTER (
        ADDCOLUMNS (
            SUMMARIZE ( ALL ( dim_date ), dim_date[year], dim_date[month] ),
            "MonthKey", dim_date[year] * 100 + dim_date[month],
            "Val",
                VAR y = dim_date[year]
                VAR m = dim_date[month]
                RETURN
                    COALESCE (
                        CALCULATE (
                            [Net Units],
                            REMOVEFILTERS ( dim_date ),
                            dim_date[year] = y,
                            dim_date[month] = m
                        ),
                        0
                    )
        ),
        [MonthKey] < _lastKey
    )
VAR _n   = COUNTROWS ( _m )
VAR _min = MINX ( _m, [Val] )
VAR _max = MAXX ( _m, [Val] )
VAR _rng = IF ( _max = _min, 1, _max - _min )
RETURN
    CONCATENATEX (
        _m,
        FORMAT ( _p + DIVIDE ( RANKX ( _m, [MonthKey], , ASC ) - 1, _n - 1 ) * ( _w - 2 * _p ), "0.0", "en-US" )
            & ","
            & FORMAT ( _h - _p - DIVIDE ( [Val] - _min, _rng ) * ( _h - 2 * _p ), "0.0", "en-US" ),
        " ",
        [MonthKey], ASC
    )

measures.name: Card Net Units
measures.expression:
VAR _label = "Net Units" -- EDIT: card name VAR _icon = "" -- EDIT: icon VAR _v = [Net Units] -- EDIT: the KPI measure VAR _val = FORMAT ( DIVIDE ( _v, 1000000000 ), "0.00", "en-US" ) & "bn" -- EDIT: number format VAR _pts = [Sparkline Net Units] -- EDIT: this KPI's sparkline VAR _g = [Net Units YoY %] -- EDIT: this KPI's growth measure -- ===== below this line: do not edit ===== VAR _fill = SWITCH ( TRUE (), ISBLANK ( _g ), "#EBEBEB", _g >= 0, "#9FD89F", "#EEACB2" ) VAR _txt = IF ( ISBLANK ( _g ), "No prior year", IF ( _g >= 0, "▲ ", "▼ " ) & FORMAT ( ABS ( _g ), "0.0%" ) ) VAR _ctx = [YoY Card Label] VAR _area = _pts & " 117,36 3,36" RETURN "
" & _label & "
" & _val & "
" & _txt & " " & _ctx & "
"

measures.name: YoY Card Label
measures.expression:
VAR _first = CALCULATE ( MIN ( dim_date[date] ), ALL ( dim_date ) )
VAR _start = MIN ( dim_date[date] )
VAR _end   = MAX ( dim_date[date] )
RETURN
    SWITCH (
        TRUE (),
        _start < EDATE ( _first, 12 ) && _end >= EDATE ( _first, 12 ), "Latest YTD vs same period LY",
        EDATE ( _start, -12 ) < _first, "No prior year",
        "vs same period LY"
    )
